say:1:1110518001:1.text: Wow! You guys came back safely!
say:1:1110518001:1.source_cn: 真高兴！我就知道会再次见到你们！

say:2:1110518002:1.text: Everyone, let's give some warm applause to these two brave warriors from the Uru Clan! They triumphantly returned after completing the <style="highlight">Trial of Wisdom</style> with the Huntsman's Necklace!
say:2:1110518002:1.source_cn: 曼卡拉的朋友们，最热烈的掌声送给乌尔氏族的两位勇士！他...

say:3:1110518003:1.text: We are witnessing an unprecedented miracle in the history of the Warsong Festival!
say:3:1110518003:1.source_cn: 我要提醒诸位的是，我们正在见证战歌节历史上前所未有的奇迹！

say:4:1110518004:1.text: Participating for the first time at such a young age! And the fact that they've actually secured a spot in the official Warsong Festival!
say:4:1110518004:1.source_cn: 初次参与试炼！并且还是如此年轻的参赛者！一举拿下战歌节...

say:6:1110518005:0.text: The chance to participate in the Warsong Festival... This feels like a dream come true.
say:6:1110518005:0.source_cn: 呜哇，太好了……居然能正式参与战歌节，真的像做梦一样……

say:8:1110518006:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, thank you. The day Alsa met you was truly a stroke of luck.
say:8:1110518006:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, thank you. The day Alsa met you was truly a stroke of luck.
say:8:1110518006:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, thank you. The day Alsa met you was truly a stroke of luck.

choice_prompt:9:1110518006.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, thank you. The day Alsa met you was truly a stroke of luck.
choice_prompt:9:1110518006.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，谢谢你。那天阿尔萨能遇到你，是我们的幸运。
choice_prompt:9:1110518006.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, thank you. The day Alsa met you was truly a stroke of luck.
choice_prompt:9:1110518006.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, thank you. The day Alsa met you was truly a stroke of luck.

say:10:1110518007:1.text: Don't be so modest, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! We really couldn't have gotten here without you.
say:10:1110518007:1.male: Don't be so modest, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! We really couldn't have gotten here without you.
say:10:1110518007:1.female: Don't be so modest, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! We really couldn't have gotten here without you.

say:11:1110518009:1.text: Hey y'all! There's still some time before the official preliminaries start.
say:11:1110518009:1.source_cn: 锵锵！离正式的初赛还有段时间，曼卡拉要要开始正式的忙碌...

say:12:1110518010:1.text: What are your plans? Are you going to go celebrate?
say:12:1110518010:1.source_cn: 你们有什么计划？要用来庆祝吗？

say:13:1110518011:1.text: Maybe! I'm thinking about going back to the Uru Clan to visit everyone. I miss them so much!
say:13:1110518011:1.source_cn: 或许吧！我也有点想回乌尔氏族看看，好想念氏族的大家！

say:14:1110518012:1.text: Rather than celebrating, I think we should use this time to recharge. After all, in the official matches, we'll face completely different opponents.
say:14:1110518012:1.source_cn: 比起庆祝，更该用这段时间养精蓄锐。毕竟在正式赛中，我们...

say:15:1110518013:1.source_cn: 没错，要的就是这个精神！

say:16:1110518014:1.text: Will the young Soren and Alsa make it to the finals and stand atop the Mars Peak? Let's wait and see!
say:16:1110518014:1.source_cn: 年轻的索恩和阿尔萨，能否闯进决赛，屹立在战神峰顶？让我...

say:18:1110518008:1.text: I remember you're hoping to get to Mars Peak. Alsa and I will work hard to make it to the finals!
say:18:1110518008:1.source_cn: 我记得你的目的地是战神峰。我和阿尔萨会努力进入决赛的。
say:18:1110518008:1.male: I remember you're hoping to get to Mars Peak. Alsa and I will work hard to make it to the finals!
say:18:1110518008:1.female: I remember you're hoping to get to Mars Peak. Alsa and I will work hard to make it to the finals!

choice:9:1:2.text: Couldn't have done it without me!
choice:9:1:2.male: Couldn't have done it without me!
choice:9:1:2.female: Couldn't have done it without me!
